title.narrative: EU contribution to the Municipal Development Programme, phase 3

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to enhance the institutional capacity of municipalities in the West Bank and Gaza for more available, accountable and sustainable service delivery. The specific objective is: Services delivery for municipalities in Gaza Strip (7 municipalities) for essential services is improved. This 7 municipalities are: Jabalia, Beit Lahia, Deir Al Balah, Gaza, Khan Younis, Rafah, Nusairat. It will benefit 144,150 direct beneficiaries and 328,001 indirect beneficiaries. This programme supporta decentralised functions of government
